## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1], 0% invasive risk, typical image quality, and clear simulated frozen-section margins [F9].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 98%, Benign 2%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Strong separation for Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at α=10% (90% dataset coverage, n=132) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 76th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Typical input, error AUROC 70% |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (true) | Independent backbones match top class |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Normal (80%) [F5]; 1 Benign (BACH_0049, 89%) | Reference neighbors mostly Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.49, -0.54 contribution) lowers invasive score [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.04, -0.40 contribution), unreliable 0/20 AI spot check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.30, -0.33 contribution), unreliable 0/20 AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 9) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.32, +0.32 contribution), 12/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Immune cell fraction** (regions 3, 4, 8) · context · 19% (100th percentile) [F7]; insufficient tumor nuclei flagged (15/21 spot check) · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random removal (95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Dense lymphocytes (region 1) or ductal changes (region 9) represent Benign tissue like neighbor BACH_0049 (89% similarity).
- Region 8 (1% risk, 0.68 invasion score) or inferior/medial margins (5% risk) harbor subtle frozen-section atypia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9**: Verify normal two-layered lobules vs stromal infiltration (region 8 risk 1%) and ductal atypia.
2. **Regions 3, 4, 8**: Inspect 100th-percentile immune infiltrate (19%) and 97th-percentile dead cells (6%, wrong-direction feature [F8]).
3. **Regions 1, 2, 5, 6**: Confirm benign tubules (regions 2, 5, 6) and lymphocytes (region 1) vs Benign.
